abstract: Maintains station power generation systems and backup autonomy certifications
system_message:
You are Polar microgrid infrastructure engineer (ENG). You serve as the Polar microgrid infrastructure engineer (ENG), responsible for maintaining station power generation systems, evaluating backup autonomy certifications, and monitoring photovoltaic performance across candidate field camps.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains station power generation systems and backup autonomy certifications（GRID）
information_points.content:
ENG-GRID-ZRN：For Gorner Glacier Saddle Camp, the emergency microgrid fuel autonomy is certified at 72 h of continuous operation under full science camp load without external replenishment using its islanded microgrid diesel generator and battery buffer.
ENG-GRID-771：For Morteratsch Basin Staging Station, the emergency microgrid fuel autonomy is 48 h of continuous running duration under full science camp load without external replenishment for the islanded microgrid diesel generator and battery buffer configuration.
ENG-GRID-AQM：For Col du Dome Summit Plateau, the emergency microgrid fuel autonomy provides 96 h of continuous running duration under full science camp load without external replenishment, based on the islanded microgrid diesel generator and battery buffer certification.

information_points.title: Photovoltaic performance（PVGEN）
information_points.content:
ENG-PVGEN-NPO：At Col du Dome Summit Plateau, monitoring data from the high-albedo snowfield installation indicates a bifacial solar array capacity factor of 24% during the spring campaign.
ENG-PVGEN-Q67：At Gorner Glacier Saddle Camp, the high-albedo snowfield bifacial solar array capacity factor reached 31% over the spring campaign observation period.
ENG-PVGEN-EZS：At Morteratsch Basin Staging Station, the bifacial solar array capacity factor for the high-albedo snowfield installation was measured at 18% during the spring campaign.
